```{r load libraries}
#packages (some packages might require dependent packages)
library(Matrix)
library(Seurat)
library(Signac)
library(patchwork)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(magrittr)
library(harmony)
library(clustree)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(msigdbr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(IRanges)
library(Biostrings)
library(biomaRt)
library(DESeq2)

library(scCustomize)
library(openxlsx)
library(rGREAT)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
```

```{r set seed}
set.seed(6)
```

```{r load object}
sobj <- readRDS("output/objects/atlas.RDS")
```

```{r a}
DimPlot(sobj, reduction="wnn.umap", 
      group.by = "sample_id") + ggtitle("")
```


```{r b}
devcolor <- c("Fetal" =  "#0D0887", "Infant" = "#7E03A8", "Child" ="#CC4678","Adolescent" = "#F89441","Adult" = "#F0F921")
DimPlot(sobj, reduction="wnn.umap", 
      group.by = "dev.group", cols=devcolor) + ggtitle("")
```

```{r c}
DimPlot(sobj, reduction="wnn.umap", 
      split.by = "sample_id", group.by = "sample_id", ncol = 11) + NoLegend() + ggtitle("")
```
